Role & responsibilities




Design, build and maintain AI solutions on Azure using Azure AI services, Azure AI Foundry, and the Azure AI Agentic Framework, with a focus on PaaS and serverless architectures for end-to-end AI platforms.

Build solutions that provide availability, performance and stability in our systems, services and products at scale, including support for large-scale AI model inference, agentic workflows, and real-time data retrieval.

Work in conjunction with demand teams and business users to understand functionality, scalability, performance, security and integration requirements for both AI and application use cases.

Propose and implement architectures using native Azure AI services, automation and serverless technology in a complex multi-tenant environment; develop both frontend (Angular, React) and backend (Python) components to deliver complete, user-facing AI applications.

Collaborate within the organization to build secure IaaS, PaaS and SaaS environments in Azure/AWS that support AI platform operational requirements and enterprise-grade governance.

Define and implement CI/CD pipelines for AI application development and ML model lifecycle management, covering training, validation, deployment, and ongoing model governance.

Understand enterprise information security requirements and drive adherence for cloud workloads, applying controls and governance needed for sensitive data used in AI solutions and applications.

Develop and maintain documentation for built Azure systems, AI platform components, and procedures; include runbooks, architecture diagrams, and guidance for operating large-scale AI and data pipelines.

Craft and evangelize secure cloud platform and product requirements, incorporating cost management and performance optimization strategies for computeintensive workloads.

Embrace a culture of continuous service improvement and service excellence, with regular reviews of platform performance, cost and reliability.

Stay current on cloud & AI industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices.

Preferred candidate profile




Overall 8+ years experience in cloud and software development, with the most recent 3 years focused on AI platform development and Azure AI services


Proven full stack development experience using Python (backend), Angular and/or React (frontend), with a track record of delivering end-to-end AI-powered web applications

Hands-on experience implementing enterprise-grade Azure AI solutions, including Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, and Azure AI Agentic Framework

Strong knowledge of cloud networking and application security, infrastructure hardening, security baselines, web server and database security

Knowledge of Azure Cloud security strategies, tools and compliance frameworks, with the ability to apply IAM, encryption and network segmentation to AI and data workloads

Ability to communicate clearly and effectively on status, progress and risks to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Azure Solutions Architect Expert and/or Azure AI Engineer Associate certifications preferred; additional AI or security certifications are a plus

Knowledge of large-scale software development and CI/CD processes, including ML model CI/CD and reproducible workflows, is a plus

Demonstrated experience building reliable, scalable, secure, data-driven process automation for compliance, operationalization and lifecycle management of cloud workloads


Competencies and Behaviors:


Highly self-motivated with the ability to identify areas of focus and tackle new challenges with or without direction

Must be able to communicate effectively and build solid relationships with individuals at all levels, in multiple geographies and business functions

Strong oral, written, and presentation abilities - able to convey risk to all levels of the business, from C-level executives to operations and development teams

Strong business acumen with the ability to build business cases for technology initiatives and to effectively communicate the value proposition to non-technical stakeholders

Demonstrated ability to work under pressure

Ability to work within a dynamic and fast-paced international environment

Ability to build rapport with other team members and relevant teams

Very good communication and negotiations skills

Technically innovative, able to express technical and non-technical concepts in clear verbal and written English

Very good skills to document complex concepts in a comprehensive, yet readable manner

Encourages people to be open and share their views

Ability to use own initiative to solve technical problems, considering a range of options that meet the needs of all stakeholders

Takes responsibility for projects and strategic initiatives

Demonstrate clear and measurable results through the development of KPIs, goals and milestones, delivery Focused

Ambitious and competitive

Drive innovation and best practice

Strive for standardization and simplification in all aspects of work

Perks and benefits

jobs.job_description:
About the Role

Our client is seeking a Senior Python Engineer (AI, ML & Agentic AI) to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI-powered applications. The ideal candidate has strong Python engineering fundamentals combined with hands-on expertise in AI/ML, Generative AI, LLM frameworks, RAG pipelines, and AI agent systems. This role is primarily AI/ML focused, with a strong emphasis on building scalable, secure, and well-governed LLM-based solutions.




Key Responsibilities

Design and develop AI/ML and AI-powered applications using Python, with FastAPI as the primary framework (Django and Flask also used).
Build and optimize RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines using LLMs, embeddings, and vector databases.
Design and execute evaluation frameworks for single-agent and multi-agent systems to measure task completion, reasoning quality, tool usage, and workflow efficiency.
Develop GenAI solutions using LangChain, LangGraph, and LlamaIndex.
Build AI agents and multi-agent workflows for business process automation.
Implement prompt engineering, retrieval evaluation, and hallucination reduction techniques.
Design and enforce LLM guardrails and governance frameworks (content filtering, output validation, safety policies, compliance, and audit logging).
Build REST APIs and microservices to integrate AI/ML components with backend systems.
Deploy AI/ML services using AWS or GCP services, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Work with cloud AI platforms: AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI, or OpenAI APIs.
Monitor AI/ML model performance, cost, latency, and accuracy in production environments.



Required Skills

5+ years of strong hands-on Python development experience.
Practical experience with Django, Django REST Framework, FastAPI, or Flask.
Solid understanding of AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, embeddings, RAG, and semantic search.
Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, RAG evaluation, re-ranking, and hallucination handling.
Experience implementing LLM guardrails and governance frameworks (safety, compliance, monitoring, and risk controls for AI systems).
Experience with LLM frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex.
Experience with ML/AI libraries: Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers.
Experience with vector databases: Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate, Milvus, or pgvector.
Good knowledge of AWS Bedrock (model invocation, RAG, and integration with S3, Lambda, Glue, Athena, and OpenSearch).
Strong understanding of REST API development, microservices architecture, and API security best practices.
Hands-on experience with AWS or GCP services, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI).
Experience with relational and NoSQL databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or Redis.



Preferred Skills

Experience with advanced AI/ML techniques and frameworks.
Familiarity with cloud-native application development and deployment.
Knowledge of data governance and compliance in AI systems.



Qualifications

5-8 years of professional experience in AI/ML development.
Demonstrated experience in building and deploying production-grade AI applications.
Strong debugging and problem-solving abilities.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.



About YMinds.AI

YMinds.AI is a premier talent solutions company specializing in sourcing and delivering elite developers with expertise in cutting-edge technologies. We help global enterprises and fast-growing startups accelerate their product development by connecting them with engineers who excel in building intelligent, scalable, and future-ready systems. Our clients are at the forefront of innovation, and we enable their success by providing exceptional talent that drives technological advancement.




Keywords

Senior Python Engineer, AI Engineer, ML Engineer, Generative AI, LLM, RAG, FastAPI, Django, Flask, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AWS, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, REST APIs, Microservices, AI Governance, AI Applications, Python Development, #Python #AI #MachineLearning #GenerativeAI #LLM #FastAPI #Django #CloudComputing #TechHiring #JobDescription

Role & responsibilities

ROLE SUMMARY

The AI Engineer builds AI features: RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, LLM integrations and ML capabilities. This role sits in the Build Team and is responsible for implementation and delivery of AI components. Depending on interview performance, the candidate is placed as a developer who works from a design or as an engineer who owns the design as well.




RESPONSIBILITIES

Implement RAG pipelines document ingestion, chunking, embedding, vector store loading, retrieval and response generation

– Build agentic workflows — LLM-driven processes with tool use, loops and error handling

– Integrate LLM APIs into product features — extract, classify, summarise and generate structured outputs

– Write and maintain an LLM evaluation suite — test cases, metrics, regression tracking

– Build FastAPI endpoints that expose AI capabilities to other services and front-ends

– Participate in design reviews and contribute to architecture decisions





Preferred candidate profile




REQUIRED SKILLS

– Python — clean, reviewable, testable code. Not script-level, production-level.

– LLM API usage — OpenAI, Anthropic or Azure OpenAI SDK. Streaming, function calling, token management.

– RAG implementation — has built at least one retrieval pipeline end-to-end

– Vector databases — has loaded and queried at least one (Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector)

– FastAPI — has built and deployed at least one REST API

– Git and Docker — standard development workflow




ADDITIONAL SKILLS (increase placement level)

– LangChain, LlamaIndex or LangGraph — used in a real project, not documentation examples

– LLM evaluation — has built automated test suites, not just manual review

– Agent design — can design a tool-use loop with memory and error recovery, not just implement one

– Fine-tuning — has fine-tuned a model (LoRA/QLoRA) and understands when to use it

Key Responsibilities:
Implement agents, tools, and MCP servers on top of Strands (or comparable framework) and AWS Bedrock AgentCore.
Wire up agent harnesses, memory stores, and tool integrations defined by the senior engineer.
Monitor running agents - traces, evals, failure triage, and routine maintenance.
Prototype quickly against new ideas (new tools, prompts, memory strategies) and contribute to evals.
Requirements:
1-3 years of Python experience; strong fundamentals in clean code, testing, and version control.
Working knowledge of LLMs and at least one agent framework (Strands, CrewAI, Agno, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, or similar).
Exposure to AWS (Bedrock, Lambda, IAM); willingness to go deep on Bedrock AgentCore.
Curiosity about MCP, tool use, and agent memory/context patterns.
Core AI Skill Requirements:
Securin is committed to becoming an AI-native organization where GenAI is embedded into how every team works - not just as an occasional assistant, but as a core part of delivery, operations, and how our expertise compounds over time. We expect every employee to actively integrate GenAI tools into daily workflows - automating routine tasks, accelerating research and analysis, drafting documents, and building reusable AI-powered processes for their function. You should understand the limitations of GenAI (including inaccuracies and data sensitivity boundaries), follow data classification rules, and continuously improve your AI proficiency. As you grow, we expect you to move beyond using GenAI to building with it - designing agent workflows, contributing reusable skills, and helping Securin compound its Proactive Exposure Management expertise faster than any competitor can replicate. Demonstrated ability to use GenAI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) for daily work - drafting, research, summarization, data analysis, code generation, or workflow automation as relevant to the role. Working knowledge of GenAI limitations including hallucination risk, context window constraints, and data sensitivity boundaries; ability to validate AI-generated output before acting on it.
